summary: Some systems, such as WebRTC, receive several kinds of packets on a single port and must tell them apart. RFC 7983 defined a scheme for separating DTLS, STUN, SRTP, ZRTP and TURN traffic. This document updates RFC 7983 and RFC 5764 so QUIC packets can share the same socket as well.

eli5.summary: Think of one mailbox that gets letters in several languages. This document teaches the mail sorter how to spot one more language, QUIC, so it goes to the right reader.

questions: can quic share a port with dtls and stun
